easyPrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger.
Resolve the Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Wispweaver Angel's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Wispweaver Angel's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 4.
